## Required

One field: the shared trip ID. The ten departure and return fields are optional.

## Available

All 67 trips in the 2025 selection have both port links, port codes and harbour coordinates.

Recorded vessel trip dates are available. ROS port and country correspondences still need confirmation.

Use departure at **00:00** and return at **23:59**, as agreed reporting conventions rather than measured times.

This convention applies only to vessel movements; the separate observer-date decision remains open.

## To decide

Confirm the time zone, canonical ROS port codes and whether harbour coordinates describe the actual endpoints.

Identify at-sea departures or returns; port coordinates cannot supply at-sea locations.

Leave unsupported optional values empty. Final delivery scope remains open.

The database permits an empty sheet because these details share the vessel record. IOTC rules remain open.
